title: Creating Your First Content Entry
excerpt: Learn how to create and manage content in HaruCMS with our step-by-step guide. We'll walk you through creating your first entry and understanding the editor.
content:
Now that you've installed HaruCMS, it's time to create your first content entry. This tutorial will guide you through the entire process, from accessing the admin panel to publishing your first piece of content.

Accessing the Admin Panel

To begin creating content, you'll need to log into the HaruCMS admin panel. Navigate to your site's admin URL (typically /admin) and enter your credentials. Once logged in, you'll see the main dashboard with navigation options.

Understanding Collections

Before creating an entry, it's important to understand collections. Collections are like content types in HaruCMS—they define what fields your content will have. For example, a blog collection might have fields for title, content, tags, and author, while a portfolio collection might have fields for project name, images, and description.

HaruCMS comes with a pre-configured blog collection, but you can create as many collections as you need for different content types.

Creating Your First Entry

To create a new entry:

  1. Navigate to the Content section in the sidebar
  2. Select your collection (e.g., "Blog")
  3. Click the New Entry button
  4. Fill in the required fields (marked with an asterisk)
  5. Add optional content like excerpts, tags, or featured images
  6. Set the status to Published when ready
  7. Click Save Entry

The Content Editor

The HaruCMS editor is designed for simplicity and efficiency. Each field type provides appropriate controls:

  • Text fields are simple input boxes
  • Rich text fields provide a WYSIWYG editor for formatted content
  • Media fields let you upload and select images or files
  • Tag fields allow you to add multiple tags with autocomplete

The editor automatically saves drafts as you work, so you don't have to worry about losing your progress. You can switch between draft and published status at any time.

Best Practices

When creating content in HaruCMS:

  • Always write descriptive titles and slugs
  • Use excerpts to provide a preview of your content
  • Tag your entries for better organization
  • Set appropriate publish dates for scheduling

Congratulations! You've created your first entry in HaruCMS. In the next tutorial, we'll explore the different fieldtypes available and how to use them effectively.
